sources.text: Car does not display the correct amount of fuel remaining once it hits half a tank left.  Can read quarter of a tank remaining, and the distance to empty meter shows 40 miles.  Or it will show 97 miles to empty and car will be on empty on fuel gauge.  Then once I arrive at my destination, they flip.  Driving 3 miles reports driving over 10-15 miles from distance to empty, the gauge starts moving.  Never an accurate reading.
